title: Understanding Zero-One Loss
text: The zero-one loss is a measure of accuracy. It counts the number of incorrect predictions made by the model. Unlike cross-entropy loss, which focuses on probabilities, zero-one loss directly evaluates the model's predictions.

title: Parameters in Zero-One Loss
text: In zero-one loss, both the parameters beta and T are adjusted to minimize the number of incorrect predictions. This is different from cross-entropy loss, where only beta is adjusted.

hintAnswer: Zero-one loss optimizes both beta and T while cross-entropy loss optimizes only beta.
